title: Localization of the first factor in arbitrary derived tensor cohomology models
statement: Let $R,A,B,A_q,D$ be commutative rings with compatible maps $R\to A\to A_q$, $R\to B$, and maps $A\otimes_R B\to D$, $A_q\otimes_R B\to D$ inducing the same maps from $A,B,A_q$. Let $S\subseteq A$ be a multiplicative submonoid and let $A_q$ be its localization. For each integer $i$ and each cochain complex $Q$ of $A$-modules, and for all cohomology models $L$ of $Q\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}B$ and $K$ of $(A_q\otimes_A Q)\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}B$ [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], there are $D$-linear isomorphisms $D\otimes_{A\otimes_R B}H_L^i\cong D\otimes_{A_q\otimes_R B}H_K^i$. The family is natural for chain maps, where model morphisms are characterized by the counits and cohomology identifications. It carries localized comparison maps to each other using the termwise tensor-associativity identification $d\otimes x\mapsto d\otimes(1\otimes x)$. Complexes, extension functors and cohomology comparisons are as in [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology]. No localization of $R$ or $B$, no flatness of $A/R$, and no flatness of $D$ is required.

proof.text: For each Q,L,K obtain the uniquely characterized first-factor localization isomorphism. Choose this pointwise family; the generator formula, proved unique by ExtendScalars.hom_ext, determines the selected data.
Apply the comparison-square lemma to each selected isomorphism and its characterization, for every tau with the required pure-tensor formula.
Apply naturality of characterized first-factor maps to the selected maps for Q and Qprime and the four specified equations for delta,g,epsilon,h.

theorem derivedTensor_first_localization_models
    (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S Aq] (i : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
        (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
        (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq B ((extend A Aq).obj Q) D),
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj
            (L.cohomology i) ≅
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (Aq ⊗[R] B) D)).obj
            (K.cohomology i),
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
          (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
          (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq B ((extend A Aq).obj Q) D)
          (τ : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ≅
            ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (Aq ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap Aq (Aq ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
                ((extend A Aq).obj Q)),
          (∀ (j : ℤ) (d : D) (x : Q.X j),
            τ.hom.f j (d ⊗ₜ[A, (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))] x) =
              d ⊗ₜ[Aq, (algebraMap (Aq ⊗[R] B) D).comp
                (algebraMap Aq (Aq ⊗[R] B))] ((1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[A, algebraMap A Aq] x)) →
          L.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ.hom i =
            (e Q L K).hom ≫ K.localizedComparison i) ∧
      (∀ (Q Q' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : Q ⟶ Q')
          (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
          (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq B ((extend A Aq).obj Q) D)
          (L' : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q' D)
          (K' : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq B ((extend A Aq).obj Q') D)
          (δ : L.derived ⟶ L'.derived) (ε : K.derived ⟶ K'.derived)
          (g : L.cohomology i ⟶ L'.cohomology i)
          (h : K.cohomology i ⟶ K'.cohomology i),
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) δ ≫
            L'.counit = L.counit →
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map g ≫
              (L'.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (L.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (L.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict R A).map f)))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (δ.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict R A).obj Q')))) →
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) ε ≫
            K'.counit = K.counit →
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] Aq ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map h ≫
              (K'.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (K.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (K.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict R Aq).map ((extend A Aq).map f))))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (ε.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict R Aq).obj ((extend A Aq).obj Q'))))) →
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).map g ≫
            (e Q' L' K').hom =
          (e Q L K).hom ≫
            (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (Aq ⊗[R] B) D)).map h)
